name: Gmail
description: Search and read Gmail, download attachments to the current task, create drafts, and send messages. Account authorization is managed by Cindy.
whenToUse: Use for Gmail messages and attached logs/files. To analyze an attachment, read with download_attachments=true, then open the returned files. Connect an account in plugin details first.

gmail_accounts.description: List the Gmail accounts connected to this plugin and their status. Accounts must be authorized separately in the Gmail plugin details.

gmail.description: read lists attachments; download_attachments saves IDs. Set save_dir at ghost_call top level, not args; absent: workdir, invalid: error. 16 MiB/file,16/call. Check complete, remaining IDs, body_error/status; unknown: inspect attempted_path before retry. Send needs intent. modify_labels unavailable.
